decisions.reason: As a very recent launch with its own website page and clear fit to the firm's dental workflow materials business, management would likely continue backing it rather than abandon an invested product after only a short market test.
This thermoforming blank matches the company's established materials and laboratory offering, and the visible standalone promotion increases commitment pressure to keep it on the market in 2019.

Even with more limited web visibility, the UV-curing lacquer still fits the firm's quality-oriented lab consumables portfolio, and escalation of commitment makes an early withdrawal unlikely so soon after launch.

The intraoral contrast spray was publicly highlighted on its own page and supports the firm's digital and clinical workflow direction, so management would be inclined to persist and attribute any slow uptake to temporary market development.

The custom earmold line sits squarely within the firm's hearing-care customer base and custom manufacturing capabilities, making it strategically relevant enough for management to continue supporting it in 2019.

Custom hearing protection earmolds leverage the same earmold know-how, channels, and production resources, so a large German manufacturer with recent investment in the line would likely retain it rather than reverse course immediately.
